metadata.scope: aia.tinyoakstudio.com homepage (Tier 2: rendered DOM + axe-core + runtime checks)
audit_methods: Pattern checks for semantic HTML, keyboard traps, labels, reflow, motion, AEO structure, and site-level agent-readiness files when a directory is scanned
Runtime behavior, contrast ratios, and screen-reader task completion were not fully verified

findings.legal_exposure: May affect ADA / EAA / JIS / Taiwan accessibility expectations depending on deployment context.
findings.title: Declared page language does not match the content
findings.affected_users: Screen-reader users (wrong pronunciation rules) and machine-translation users
findings.description: Content-language mismatch: declared "en-us" but 66% of content is CJK. A wrong language declaration is worse than a missing one. Assistive technology applies confidently wrong pronunciation and translation rules.
findings.fix: Set <html lang> to the actual content language (detected: han).

findings.legal_exposure: May affect ADA / EAA / JIS / Taiwan accessibility expectations depending on deployment context.
findings.title: Heading level is skipped
findings.description: Heading jumps from h1 to h4.
findings.fix: Use a continuous heading hierarchy or adjust the visual style without changing semantic level.

findings.title: Image is missing alt text
findings.affected_users: Blind and low-vision users using screen readers
findings.description: An image without alt text is silent or announced poorly by assistive technology.
findings.fix: Add meaningful alt text, or alt="" for purely decorative images.

testing_recommendations: Run keyboard-only walkthrough of the primary flow.
Run a live browser audit with Playwright + axe-core when a page is available.
Listen to the page with VoiceOver or NVDA for the core task.
Treat this static score as a regression baseline, not a completion certificate.

llm_judgment.label: LLM judgment — not reproducible, excluded from the machine score

items.observation: Runtime reflow verified at 320px viewport: scrollWidth 305 = clientWidth 305, no horizontal overflow, no overflowing elements found. The static 'Large fixed width detected' warning comes from image width attributes and media-query-guarded CSS, not an actual reflow failure.
items.note: Runtime evidence contradicts the static warning; treat 1.4.10 as passing.

items.observation: Focus-visible indicators could not be conclusively measured (programmatic focus does not trigger :focus-visible heuristics). Skip link shows a box-shadow when focused; other links showed no outline under programmatic focus. Per Beacon guidance this capture class is a known false-positive source.
items.note: Recommend a human Tab-through pass; not scored.

items.observation: meta robots is 'noindex, nofollow' and the page sits behind a WordPress post password — consistent with a staging site. The Lighthouse SEO score of 46 is dominated by this intentional state; re-check SEO after launch.
items.note: Intentional staging configuration, not a defect.

items.observation: Both confirmed contrast failures use colors outside the AIA brand palette (#e4bc54 header background, #e8593a CTA). The brand style guide's own contrast matrix (C:/Code/AIA/CLAUDE.md, brand-style-guide.html v1.0) already provides AA/AAA-passing pairs; aligning the WordPress theme to the brand tokens fixes both findings simultaneously.
prefers-reduced-motion has partial coverage: 3 media-query rules present against 24 animation-related rules (Kadence theme defaults). No autoplaying media, no flashing content observed.

The whole homepage exposes only 10 focusable elements (skip link, logo, 1 nav item, mobile menu buttons, 3 empty social links). Body content contains no in-page links, and the single content CTA is not focusable. Keyboard/AT users effectively have nothing to operate on this page.

Mixed zh-TW/en content is declared lang="en-US" with no lang subtags anywhere. CJK screen reader users get English TTS voices for Chinese text. Fix html lang to zh-TW and wrap English passages in lang="en" spans where pronunciation matters.

lighthouse.note_en: Lighthouse scores swing run-to-run with device emulation, CPU throttle, and machine load — treat them as directional, not absolute. This section is a supplementary signal and is NOT folded into Beacon's accessibility score.
